draft.reply_body:
Hello Minna,

Thanks for letting us know the excavator is ready to come back. We can arrange collection from your site in Kempele rather than you bringing it in yourself.

Could you let us know your preferred day and a rough time window? We'll check what we can fit in and confirm a collection slot with you.

Once the excavator has been checked in and confirmed undamaged and complete, your deposit will be refunded in full within five working days, as per our standard policy.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
